1.Na3 e5 2.d3 Bxa3 3.bxa3 d5 4.e3 c5 5.R.strategy: Puts the rook on the half-open b-file, the one real asset White got for the doubled pawns: it attacks the b7 pawn, which the c8-bishop must keep guarded. White plays for activity against Black's wing, accepting a poor pawn structure for it.
1.Na3 e5 2.d3 Bxa3 3.bxa3 d5 4.e3 c5 5.R.name: Durkin Opening: Celadon Variation
